# Rise Above Performance Training

> > Underground strength and conditioning gym in Belmont, CA specializing in kettlebell training, athlete development, and first responder fitness.

Founded in 2008 by Doug Fioranelli (RKC II, CSCS) and Jeffery Wu, Rise Above Performance Training serves the Bay Area with programs for adults, youth athletes, and tactical populations. The gym has worked with professional athletes from the 49ers, Giants, and Oakland Raiders, emphasizing RKC kettlebell methods, circuit training, and sports performance conditioning.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Training (RKC Method)
- Sports Performance & Athlete Training
- Youth Strength & Conditioning
- First Responder Fitness
- Circuit Training Programs
- Adult Strength Classes
- Injury Recovery & Rehabilitation
- TRX & Unconventional Training
- Doug Fioranelli (RKC II, CSCS)
- Belmont, CA / San Mateo County
- Turkish Get Up
- Hardstyle Kettlebell Swing
- Group Training Classes
- Movement Assessment

## Kettlebell Training & Technique

- [Fix Your Kettlebell Single Arm Swing](https://riseabovestrength.com/fix-your-single-arm-swing): Hardstyle kettlebell swing technique from RKC assistant instructor
- [How NOT to Hurt Your Back During Kettlebell Swings](https://riseabovestrength.com/how-not-to-hurt-your-back-during-kettlebell-swings): Kettlebell swing prerequisites & common mistakes for back safety
- [Start Kettlebell Training Right - Week 2: Single-Sided Exercises](https://riseabovestrength.com/start-kettlebell-training-right-week-2-single-sided-exercises): Week 2 beginner kettlebell program: goblet squat, press & Turkish Get Up
- [Simple and Quick High Rep Workout](https://riseabovestrength.com/simple-and-quick-high-rep-workout): 50-rep kettlebell workout routine with four exercises
- [Climbing the Strength Ladder](https://riseabovestrength.com/climbing-the-strength-ladder): Ladder training method for strength without burnout by AJ Lee

## Injury Recovery & Rehabilitation

- [Essential Core Rehab Exercises You Should Be Doing](https://riseabovestrength.com/essential-core-rehab-exercises-you-should-be-doing): Core rehab exercises video for back pain & post-PT maintenance
- [Upper Body Rehabilitation Strategies](https://riseabovestrength.com/upper-body-rehabilitation-strategies): Shoulder rehab strategies bridging PT to training with band work
- [Lower Body Rehabilitation Strategies](https://riseabovestrength.com/lower-body-rehabilitation-strategies): Hip & knee rehab strategies bridging PT to training programs
- [Get Your Arm Unstuck and Overhead With These Simple Exercises](https://riseabovestrength.com/get-your-arm-unstuck-and-overhead-with-these-simple-exercises): Shoulder mobility exercises using foam rolling, bands & stretching
